title: Registry Index Entry
description: A single plugin entry in the Axolotl registry index (data/index.json). All plugin.yml-derived fields are re-fetched and overwritten by the sync workflow on every run — never trusted from a submission body.

id.description: GitHub owner/repo slug, used as the stable unique identifier for this plugin.

name.description: Plugin name, sourced directly from plugin.yml name field on every sync.

version.description: Latest version string from the most recent GitHub Release tag (stripped of any leading 'v' prefix). Used for display.

tag.description: Full Git tag of the latest approved release (e.g. 'v1.2.0' or 'nightly'). Includes any 'v' prefix. Used as the canonical tag identifier.

all_tags.description: All submitted stable release tags in chronological order (newest first). Only includes tags that were submitted via the approval workflow. The approval workflow appends new tags; the sync workflow never modifies this field.

dev_build.description: Latest dev/nightly build. Only populated when tag === 'nightly'. Set by the approval workflow; the sync workflow never modifies it.

api.description: Array of supported PocketMine API version strings from plugin.yml api field.

author.description: Array of author strings from plugin.yml author/authors field.

description.description: Plugin description from plugin.yml description field.

category.description: Axolotl-defined category assigned at submission time and approved by a maintainer.

keywords.description: User-submitted keywords for search. Max 10 keywords.

icon_path.description: Relative path to the icon file inside the plugin's repo, as submitted. Null means no explicit path was submitted — the sync workflow will attempt icon.png then assets/icon.png as fallbacks before using the Axolotl default icon.

icon_url.description: Resolved raw.githubusercontent.com URL for the icon. Resolution order (sync workflow): (1) submitted icon_path → (2) icon.png → (3) assets/icon.png → (4) Axolotl's own default icon. Each step is attempted only if the previous returned 404. The URL uses the literal HEAD segment (e.g. /owner/repo/HEAD/icon.png); GitHub resolves this server-side to the current default branch.

repo_url.description: Direct GitHub URL to the plugin repository.

download_url.description: URL pointing to the .phar asset on the GitHub Releases page. Always originates from the plugin's own repo, never proxied through Axolotl.

download_count.description: Total GitHub Release asset download count, fetched on every sync. Null if the asset or release data is unavailable.

stargazers_count.description: GitHub repository star count, fetched on every sync.

build_tier.description: Badge tier: 'verified' = has SLSA attestation; 'built-via-ci' = asset uploaded by github-actions[bot]; 'unverified' = manually uploaded asset; null = unknown/unavailable.

attestation_checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the attestation check last ran. Null if the check has never run or the release is unavailable.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when a maintainer added the approved label — the moment this entry was first written to the index.

last_synced_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when any field in this entry was last refreshed by the scheduled sync workflow.

unavailable.description: True if the plugin's repo went private, its release was removed, or the .phar asset is otherwise inaccessible. Plugin remains in the index as unavailable rather than being silently dropped.

featured.description: True if this plugin is featured. Featured plugins are sorted to the top of the list.

featured_marked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the featured label was added. Used to determine the oldest featured plugin when max 10 is exceeded.

submission_pr_number.description: PR number used for the initial submission. Used for tracking and featured label management.

fork.description: True if this plugin was submitted from a fork. Forks are only allowed when the original repository is not already in the registry.

forked_from.description: The original repository this plugin was forked from (e.g. 'upstream/repo'). Only populated when fork is true.
